question: Find the number of visitors who did not visit any museum opened after 2019.
gold_query: SELECT count(*) FROM visitor WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT t2.visitor_id FROM museum AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.Museum_ID = t2.Museum_ID WHERE t1.open_year > 2019)
